name: Bone
summary: Classic cartoon bone with knobbly ends, tilted on y; anim bob or wobble. For skeleton and fun scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom: the lowest point of the bone rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 400 px long; use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: angle
params.note: tilt in degrees (negative tilts the right end up)

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = lifts and settles; wobble = rocks on its lowest point

author: krakujs
